task:
Create a Pod named 'init-demo' in namespace 'default' with:

  Init container:
    - Name: init-writer
    - Image: busybox:1.35
    - Command: ['/bin/sh', '-c', 'echo init-complete > /work-dir/status.txt']
    - Mounts emptyDir volume 'shared-data' at /work-dir

  Main container:
    - Name: web
    - Image: nginx:1.21
    - Mounts the same volume 'shared-data' at /usr/share/nginx/html

Init containers run to completion before the main container starts.
Verify: kubectl exec init-demo -- cat /usr/share/nginx/html/status.txt
hints: No imperative shortcut for init containers — write YAML
spec.initContainers[] is a sibling of spec.containers[]
Volume must be declared in spec.volumes[] and mounted in both containers
detailed_hints: Add spec.initContainers: [{name: init-writer, image: busybox:1.35, command: [...], volumeMounts: [...]}]
